items.title: Mike Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2024

ctx.x: Mike Davis has fashioned a robust career as a trombonist, composer, arranger, and music educator. His history of gigs and accomplishments include tours with the Rolling Stones, sessions with Bob Dylan, and concerts with his own Hip- Bone Big Band.
Mike was interviewed via Zoom on April 1, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
